l.i: Addicta quondam progenies DeoSic fudit hostis acrior impios, Victrixque, dum Moses fidelis Tendit ad astra manus precantes.
Consulta veri quod SapientiaSemper minorem Numine te geris, Regni, vinces, hostibusque Sceptra feres metuenda cunctis.
AEternus orbis nam tibi militatRector, furentes qui quatit improbos, Virésque vasanas retundit Omne nefas animo moventes.
Quite benigno lumine respicit,Tutámque praestat: qui vigil excubat, Et fraudis authores recludens Insidias referat latentes.
Insanientum te quibus impetit,Turbátque liuor Pontificum irritus, Omnisque coniurata veros Perdere Christicolas caterua.
Te victus auro nunc parat artifexMiscere mensis toxica regiis Maltare, ni tutela Christi Fraude pium caput expediret.
Nunc Iesuites seditionibusPaces Britanni vertere ciuicis Molitur almas, téque tentat Legitimis spoliare sceptris.

page.notes: Verse printed in italic with long s rendered as s; some letters in the scan are worn or uncertain (e.g. "Maltare" possibly "Mactare", "Sceptra", "vasanas" possibly "vasanas"), and the initial of some lines is a decorative capital. Marks such as the small dash or mark after "Victrixque" and after "Tendit" are printing marks or damage and are not transcribed.
